masks-ritual.title: The mask is constructed around a circular wooden frame bound with plant fibre. At the top of the mask is a section of woven plant fibre string-work which has feathers  attached. The face of the mask is made from a rectangular piece of raw hide which has been coated with a black substance. Cut-outs in the surface form eyes. The face of the mask is decorated with strips of red textile and white paper forming a cross pattern.  [CW [OPS move] 16/9/2016]

Dance mask. The face of the mask is made of carved wood which has been stained. There are scarification marks present on the forehead, cheeks and chin. The back section of the mask is made of woven plant fibre string-work attached to the wooden front through perforations. Sections of dyed ?plant fibre representing hair are attached to the top of the mask. A small white disc is sewn into the hair above the ear on one side.  [CW [OPS move] 16/9/2016]

Dance mask and full body costume made of dyed and woven plant fibre string-work mask costume, and a carved wooden face mask. The plant fibre costume is dyed in horizontal bands and a geometric pattern at the midpoint. The mask section which is build onto a basketry framework is attached to the neck section of the costume.  The face is painted and decorated with strips of red and white paper, and red textile. A plant fibre beard and eyebrows are adhered to the face.
